items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: The interviewee discusses playing for Kennedy and being in the Eddie Alley Orchestra, but does not mention any personal interaction or relationship with Jimmy Carter, who is only mentioned by the interviewer in the context of an inaugural ball.

ctx.x: He was one of the vice presidents. But I have that kind of a relationship with people. You know that means a heck of a lot.
I’m looking at something, an inaugural ball for Jimmy Carter. January 1977. The Eddie Alley Orchestra.

Yeah. I also played for Kennedy, before he was president. I was in one truck — he was running for president, I had a big band, I had a ten piece band, we were on trucks in Oakland. And I always had an integrated band. That’s another thing that helped me out a lot.
